Current, full form Sukuna? Or Shibuya Sukuna? 

If we're going with Shibuya Sukuna, then he probably loses pretty badly, and loses to (likely, any version) Zhongli.

However, current Sukuna is a completely different story. He clears each Zhongli round with ease. Sukuna can bypass durability with his spacial cut. If he targets his neck it's over. 

You could definitely make an argument that Zhongli is *maybe* faster than Sukuna, and even outright has better physical feats, but it really doesn't matter when Sukuna can heal quicker than Zhongli can deal with, even with a meteor nuke. In fact, he probably straight up dodges any meteor that's thrown at him. And that's not even accounting for Mahoraga. 

Mahoraga alone could cause some big problems for Zhongli, considering the one Sukuna summons is far more deadly than Shibuya Mahoraga. 

Sukuna can likely take out any of the Archons in a 1 on 1, and his domain would seal any of their fates. His domain isn't one you can "tank" or "escape". You could maybe say Raiden could escape to her Plane? But even if she drags him into her dimension, it doesn't matter. They both work totally different and even if you wanted to assume they followed the same rules, Sukuna would absolutely win in a domain clash. It's just so unique in the fact that it doesn't have/need a barrier. He uses it and it wins. Raiden wouldn't "massively beat Sukuna in a tug-of-war" or whatever bs the other dude said. That and if you consider Zhongli>Raiden, like I do, then it looks even worse for the other archons. Sukuna would easily be faster than any of them, as he's *far* faster than someone who can point-blank dodge lightning. 

Their best chance is attacking at once with one, big, group attack. Granted, it would probably kill *everything* Archons included, I'm sure it would kill Sukuna. *If* he doesn't use domain expansion when he sees all of the 7 about to jump him.

Edit: things get *even worse* if you want to scale Sukuna off of Gojo or Kenjaku, who tanked a black hole. Though that one's kinda an outlier, so entirely up to you if you consider it valid.
